provenance.construction: Pair-partition CPM CSS code (Okada-Kasai arXiv:2607.14091), (J,L)=(3,8), cyclic lift P=114 (Z_114), n=8P=912, k=234 (= 2P+6). H[i*P + r, l*P + ((r - E[i][l]) mod P)] = 1 for i in 0..2, l in 0..7, r in Z_P, with the 3x8 exponent arrays over Z_114: E_x = [[7, 36, 9, 74, 72, 80, 62, 78], [87, 104, 31, 0, 102, 78, 34, 74], [102, 26, 88, 102, 97, 50, 71, 12]], E_z = [[113, 58, 99, 76, 64, 82, 38, 100], [65, 5, 67, 85, 80, 49, 70, 89], [101, 72, 45, 98, 96, 46, 28, 58]]. The arrays solve the paired-difference design system E_x[i][a] - E_x[i][b] - E_z[j][a] + E_z[j][b] = 0 for each pair (a,b) of the cube 1-factorization matching M0=(0,4)(1,7)(2,6)(3,5), M1=(0,7)(1,2)(3,4)(5,6), M2=(0,2)(1,5)(3,7)(4,6); cell (i,j) uses M[(i-j) mod 3] (solution lattice of rank 19, sampled mod P); no 4- or 6-cycles in either exponent array (Tanner girth 8); the draw was moved in the solution lattice by simulated annealing (T0=64) on the number of vanishing 8-cycle exponent sums over 15000 moves without changing k. Draw seed 72114432 from anneal run 1; temperature decreased geometrically from 64 toward 4, with validated fold and connectivity checkpoints every 200 accepted moves. The method and exponent arrays are documented in notes/912-234-22.md.
